1.DOH Food No.0960404383 Announced, June 29, 2007
2.MOHW Food No. 1021350146 Amended, August 20, 2013

法規內容.條文內容: The Standards are prescribed in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of the Act Governing Food Sanitation.
The disposable chopsticks referred in this standard are those chopsticks made from bamboo or wood, intended for direct usage without washing or rinsing, and shall not be re-used.
No discoloration, off odor and flavor, contamination, moulds, damaged by worms, foreign matter or fiber shedding shall be found in disposable chopsticks.
The sulphur dioxide residue of the disposable chopsticks shall not exceed 500 ppm.
Hydrogen peroxide and diphenol shall not be detected in the disposable chopsticks.

The Standards shall be implemented on December 1, 2007.
The promulgation of amended shall be implemented on the date of promulgation.
